question: All methods of tubal patency assessment share the same fundamental principle: a substance is introduced through the cervix under pressure, and patency is confirmed if it passes through the fallopian tubes into the peritoneal cavity.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. HSG, sonohysterography (HyCoSy/SIS), and laparoscopy with methylene blue all rely on this same principle: passage of a substance from uterine cavity through the tubes into the peritoneal cavity confirms patency.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Whether using radio-opaque dye (HSG), saline (SIS/HyCoSy), or gas (Rubin's test), the principle is the same: introduce a substance under pressure and verify peritoneal spill.
